function_v0.doc: Returns the look a seed draws: one part per trait, in the order\nchassis, ground, antenna, eyes, mouth, body, hat, arms, boots.
function_v0.name: look

cases.doc: The look names a part the art does not hold.
cases.name: InvalidLook

function_v0.doc:
Returns the picture of a member as an SVG in a data URI.

# Arguments
* `token_id` - The token; with the look it places the slipped rows.
* `look` - The look drawn by `look` when the member minted.
* `role` - The role: 1 adds the boots, 2 the vest, 3 the hat and turns
the arms gold.

# Panics
* `InvalidLook` - When the look is not one part per trait within the art.
function_v0.name: picture

function_v0.doc:
Stores the art.

# Arguments
* `art` - The art, as laid out in `art.rs`.

# Panics
* `InvalidArt` - When the art is longer than `MAX_ART`, a trait has no
part or a part does not decode inside the picture.
